name: edit_script
description: Apply a SMALL, SURGICAL code edit (1-10 lines) to GDScript files. Auto-applies changes. For large changes, call multiple times. ONLY for .gd files - NEVER for .tscn scene files. Use classdb_query to verify unfamiliar Godot class methods. After making changes, consider using run_scene to test and get_errors to check for issues.

dry_run.description: Preview only: reports whether the snippet matched and what it would produce, writes nothing. Default false.

edit.description: Edit spec: {type: "snippet_replace", file: "res://path.gd", old_snippet: "old code", new_snippet: "new code", context_before: "line above", context_after: "line below"}. Keep old_snippet SMALL (1-10 lines).
